text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> claimed victory in the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Grand cheers are showered upon her as she 
takes center stage for 1st place in the 
Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That was a great win!" "You can do it 
overseas too!" "Become the best in the 
world!" "Good luck!"――...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Amidst it all, I heard a voice: "Off you 
go!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those voices wishing to push her "dream" 
forward gave strength to <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days passed after that. At last, 
the Representative Exchange Race was about 
to begin. She heads toward the promised 
race to contend for representing Japan—
